# R14d fixtures (synthetic)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py::biomarker_design` and `write_validation_cohort` (seeded
standard-library values; no study data). Classes are case `P` (positive, the contrast numerator) and control `N`.

- signal: 15 vs 15 units, F01-F03 higher and F04-F06 lower in P by 1 (SD 0.5), 40 features.
- noise: 20 vs 20 units, 2000 pure-noise features (V152 leaky-reference and nested-CV null; V157 panels).
- repeated: 8 vs 8 subjects with two observations each and a shared subject effect (class constant within subject).
- small: 4 vs 30 units (V151 refusal).
- validation cohort: an independent cohort with the same planted signal and subject ids prefixed `V`; the overlap
  variant reuses three discovery ids.
